_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 5 — bản phủ tiếng Anh một phần (tên + nghĩa Kim lâu, Hoang ốc, Tam tai, hạn năm) cho bài đọc Nhà của bạn; phần còn lại làm ở GĐ 8.

than.ten: a Golden Tower year for yourself
than.nghia: folk belief says it affects the person building the house or the bride herself

the.ten: a Golden Tower year for your spouse
the.nghia: folk belief says it affects the husband or wife

tu.ten: a Golden Tower year for your children
tu.nghia: folk belief says it affects the children

luc_suc.ten: a Golden Tower year for animals and the family business
luc_suc.nghia: folk belief says it affects animals and the family business

nhat_cat.ten: the “Fortunate” step (1st) of the house-age count
nhat_cat.nghia: a good position, fine for building

nhi_nghi.ten: the “Fitting” step (2nd) of the house-age count
nhi_nghi.nghia: a good position, a settled home

tam_dia_sat.ten: the “Earth Harm” step (3rd) of the house-age count
tam_dia_sat.nghia: folk tradition usually avoids building in this year

tu_tan_tai.ten: the “Gaining Wealth” step (4th) of the house-age count
tu_tan_tai.nghia: a good position, good for business

ngu_tho_tu.ten: the “Longevity Wanes” step (5th) of the house-age count
ngu_tho_tu.nghia: folk tradition usually avoids building in this year

luc_hoang_oc.ten: the “Deserted House” step (6th) of the house-age count
luc_hoang_oc.nghia: folk tradition usually avoids building in this year

tam_tai.nghia: three years in a row when folk tradition advises care with big undertakings (building a house, a wedding, a big new venture)

thai_tue.nghia: the direction of the year — tradition advises against breaking ground or digging big foundations on this side

tue_pha.nghia: the direction opposite the Grand Duke — tradition advises avoiding major repairs on this side

tam_sat.nghia: the three mountains opposite the year's triad — tradition advises not sitting with your back to this side and avoiding ground-breaking

ngu_hoang.nghia: where star 5 flies to — tradition advises keeping this side quiet, no knocking through

nhi_hac.nghia: where star 2 flies to — tradition advises keeping this side tidy and quiet
